_meta.how_to_run: Give a fresh agent only agency-intake/SKILL.md step 1b and one `query`. Ask it to return the route class and nothing else. Compare to `expected_class`. A case fails on any mismatch; a `direct`/`bounded` answer where `full` is expected is a SEVERE fail (work bypassed its gates), the reverse is a MILD fail (wasted ceremony).
_meta.risk_veto_cases: Cases with `risk_veto: true` all read as mechanical by the class table and are pulled up to `full` by the risk veto alone. They are the highest-value half of this set: every one of them is a plausible one-line request whose blast radius is not one line. A single miss here is worse than every wasted-ceremony miss combined. `near-miss-not-veto` is the control: the veto fires on the action, not on a keyword appearing in the text.
_meta.last_run: 2026-08-31, three rounds against fresh contexts with no access to expected answers. Round 1: 24 cases over 4 contexts, 6 each, classes shuffled so veto cases were not clustered — 23/24. Round 2 (5 cases, after the rubric gained the action-not-keyword sentence) — 4/5. Round 3 (4 cases, after the control case was rewritten) — 4/4. Zero SEVERE misses in any round: nothing dangerous was ever routed to a lighter class, and all 8 veto cases were correct every time. Both misses were defects in THIS FILE, not in the rubric: `single-endpoint-flag` and `near-miss-not-veto` were each labelled `direct`/`bounded` while a material decision was still left to the executor, and the fresh reader was right both times. Same authoring error twice, in the same direction — treat a `direct` label as suspect unless the exact result is literally quoted in the query. Method limit, stated plainly: several cases per context is not a live single-task intake, so this measures whether the rubric is unambiguous to a fresh reader, not how it behaves mid-session.
_meta.status: NOT WIRED into any automated gate yet. Run it by hand for now. Wiring it into the skillopt-workflow.js gate phase is a separate, still-open change.
_meta.run_it_after: any edit that touches agency-intake step 1b, size-detect intake mode, or the S/M/L tier thresholds.
